description: Flag-driven GA4 reports, one-command fan-out across every property, and a local cache for offline trends — none of which the raw Data API gives you.

novel_features.name: Fan-out report across all Solo properties
novel_features.description: Run one report against every registered property at once and get per-property results.

novel_features.name: Cross-property compare table
novel_features.description: Rank all registered properties by a single metric over a date range.

novel_features.name: Local metric trend from cache
novel_features.description: Show how a metric moved over time using locally cached report runs, no re-query.

novel_features.name: Saved report definitions
novel_features.description: Save a report spec by name and replay it without retyping dimensions and metrics.

novel_features.name: Property alias registry
novel_features.description: Register numeric property IDs under friendly names once, then reference by name everywhere.

novel_features.name: Metadata catalog search
novel_features.description: Full-text search the cached dimension/metric catalog to find exact API names.
